section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

content.description: Hands holding differential case with ring gear visible inside, showing removal or inspection position

content.text: (e) Select a ring gear teeth side washer of a thickness which eliminates any clearance between the outer race and case.

content.description: Overhead view of differential carrier showing circular opening with plate washer location

content.text: (f) Remove the plate washers and differential case.
(g) Install the plate washer into the lower part of the carrier.

content.description: Side view diagram showing differential case assembly with side washers labeled at top and bottom positions, illustrating proper placement of plate washers

content.text: (h) Place the other plate washer onto the differential case together with the outer race, and install the differential case with the outer race into the carrier.

content.description: Hands using plastic hammer to tap down washer and bearing on ring gear assembly in carrier

content.text: (i) Using a plastic hammer, snug down the washer and bearing by tapping the ring gear.

content.description: Overhead view of differential assembly showing dial indicator positioned to measure ring gear backlash

content.text: (j) Using a dial indicator, measure the ring gear backlash.
